title: 3-Hour Ropes Course and Zip Line Adventure
includes: A harness, helmet, and gear will be provided.
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Must be under 265 lbs. and a minimum of 48" and 6 years old to participate
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Our self-guided adventure park is a wonderful experience for people looking for a rush, or even guests who simply want to enjoy the outdoors. Because we have different levels of height and difficulty, guests are able to do as little or as much as they like (height, age, and weight restrictions apply). Even though we are located in Dallas, you will feel like you are away from the hustle and bustle of the big city.
